reviews.summary: The 'collect the year' table and one photo per month turn generic anniversary lists into a method, with card lines that sound like real people; polish only (a fallback if the first-date place is full, 'often' softened, engraving the date).

dealbreakers: Scrapbook note says all twelve photos appear 'as polaroids that develop'. That is a claim about Ethos the code doesn't support. In src/templates/scrapbook/Template.tsx only photos[0] is the developing Polaroid. photos[1-3] go in a photo-booth strip, photos[4] is a stamp and the rest go on a roll of film (the manifest description lists all four).
reviews.summary: Dealbreaker: the Scrapbook note said all twelve photos develop as polaroids, but only the first does (the rest go in a booth strip, a stamp and a film roll). Also asked to replace two sample lines that echo other posts (wine on the shoes, asleep on the train) and fix two Spanish calques.
Asked for titles that say what's inside (dates and gifts) instead of 'use the year', in EN and ES; polish on a long-distance heading, a budget line and 'for him' in the card heading.

applied: Scrapbook note (EN, ES): first photo as a developing polaroid, the rest in a photo-booth strip, on a stamp and on a roll of film.
Sample lines replaced: the wrong bus stop; the dance move at the cousin's wedding (EN, ES); 'Gracias por todo'.
Titles: '1 year anniversary ideas for your boyfriend: dates and gifts' / 'Primer aniversario con tu novio: ideas de citas y regalos'.

Polish heading off fixes: Our Timeline countdown described as optional (EN, ES); 'Cuando ya lleváis un año…'; cotton added to the ES paper lines; 'can easily land on a weeknight'; 'If it can be engraved, put the date on it'.
rejected: Reader polish: fallback if the first-date place is full; not needed for the advice to hold.
Search polish: long-distance heading, budget half-sentence and 'for him' in the card heading; the FAQ already covers budget and the headings already match the searches.

reviews.summary: A twenty-minute method (collect the year, one photo per month) that turns the usual flat lists into dates, gifts and card lines that could only be his.
Round-1 fixes check out against the code; asked to reword the Our Timeline note, whose round-1 polish now repeated a sentence from 6-month-anniversary-ideas word for word (EN and ES).
The only result with a method that makes the usual ideas personal, plus card lines, a weeknight booking tip and a long-distance plan; the Spanish fills a gap the wedding-anniversary results leave.

applied: Our Timeline note reworded (EN, ES): 'The last screen is a line of yours to close on, plus a countdown if you add one'.
Polish heading off an accuracy fix: Scrapbook note says 'With a torn note…' instead of 'Then', since the note comes right after the first polaroid (EN, ES).
rejected: Reader polish: first-date fallback (rejected in round 1 too) and the tip's title; both optional.
Search polish: long-distance and 'for him' headings, rejected in round 1 for the same reason.
Editor polish: 'mark it somehow' and dropping 'mucho' in the ES lead; optional, not errors.

reviews.summary: It answers the search in its first sentence, then dates, gifts, the card and being apart in the order a reader asks, all built on one photo per month.
Every template note matches the code, both languages say the same thing, and the collect-the-year method makes each idea specific to him, which the ranking lists don't.
The only result with a method (collect the year, one photo per month) that makes the shared ideas personal, plus card lines, a weekday booking tip and a plan for being apart; the Spanish fills a gap.

rejected: Final-round polish, recorded not applied: reader's first-date fallback and tip title; search's long-distance heading; editor's 'early weeks' wording and dropping 'mucho' in the ES lead.
